whatIs.a: Cerita Lagu is a personalized song service from Indonesia. You answer 7 questions about someone you love, then we write lyrics from your memories together and sing them in the genre you choose, such as Pop, Ballad, Acoustic, R&B, Jazz, Dangdut or Keroncong.

account.q: Do I need to sign up first?
account.a: No. You can fill in the questionnaire and listen to the preview without an account. You only need one to save your song and unlock the full version.

duration.a: Usually just a few minutes after you send your answers. The page shows your song automatically as soon as it’s ready.

occasions.a: Almost any: birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, proposals, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, graduations, Valentine’s Day, apologies, thank-yous, farewells, or just to say “I love you”.

previewVsFull.q: What’s the difference between the preview and the full song?
previewVsFull.a: The preview plays from the start of the song to the end of the first chorus. The full song includes everything, plus the complete lyrics, ready to download and share.

payment.q: How much does it cost and how do I pay?
payment.a: The preview is always free. The full song’s price is shown in Indonesian Rupiah before you pay, including any voucher discount. You pay once per song, processed securely by DOKU.

download.q: Can I download the song and give it as a gift?
download.a: Yes. Once payment succeeds, the full song unlocks on its page right away and you can download it from your account, then play it for or send it to someone you love.

dislike.q: What if I don’t love the result?
dislike.a: You can regenerate the song from the same answers to get different lyrics and a different arrangement.

languages.a: Right now, lyrics can be written in Indonesian and English.

finalCta.title: Make them smile with a song that’s theirs alone
finalCta.body: Start now — the preview is free, no sign-up needed.

legal.prevailing: This English version is provided for convenience. If it differs from the Indonesian version, the Indonesian version prevails.

penerimaan.title: Acceptance of Terms
body: By accessing or using Cerita Lagu (the "Service"), you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.
We may update these terms at any time. The latest version is always available on this page, and using the Service after a change means you accept that version.

layanan.title: About the Service
body: Cerita Lagu creates personal songs based on the questionnaire answers you provide. Lyrics, arrangements, and vocals are generated with the help of artificial intelligence (AI).
Because songs are made by AI, every result can differ and may not always match your expectations. We do not guarantee that name pronunciation, rhymes, or musical style will be exactly as you imagine.

akun.title: Accounts & Use Without an Account
body: You can fill in the questionnaire and listen to the preview without creating an account. To save songs and unlock the full version, you need to sign in with a valid email address.
You are responsible for keeping access to your account and email confidential, and for all activity that takes place through your account.
Songs created without an account are stored on the device/browser you use. If they are not claimed to an account within 30 days, that data and those songs may be deleted automatically.

konten-pengguna.title: Questionnaire Content
body: You confirm that the stories, names, and information you enter are yours or that you have the right to use them, and that they do not infringe anyone else’s rights.

You may not enter content that contains hate speech, discrimination based on ethnicity, religion, race, or group (SARA), pornography, violence, defamation, harassment, or anything else that violates the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.
We may refuse, stop creating, or delete songs that violate these terms, without any obligation to refund.

preview.title: Preview & Regenerate
body: Every song comes with a free preview of its opening section. Listen to the preview before buying the full song.
You can regenerate a song from the same answers within the limit shown on the song page. Daily song creation may also be limited to prevent abuse.

harga.title: Pricing & Payment
body: The price of the full song is shown in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) before you pay, including any discount from a valid voucher. Payment is made once per song.
Payments are processed by our payment gateway partner (DOKU). We do not store your card or bank account details.
Orders that are not paid within the set time limit expire automatically. You can check out again at any time.
Vouchers are valid only under their own terms, validity period, and quota, cannot be exchanged for cash, and may be cancelled if misuse is suspected.

pengiriman.title: Delivery of Digital Products
body: The full song is a digital product. Once payment is confirmed, the song is unlocked immediately on the song page and can be played and downloaded through your account.

pengembalian-dana.title: Cancellations & Refunds
body: Because a preview is available before purchase and the song is delivered instantly, completed purchases cannot be cancelled or refunded for reasons of taste or a change of mind.

A refund may be given if: (a) you were charged twice for the same song; (b) payment succeeded but the song did not unlock and we cannot fix it; or (c) the song file is corrupted and we cannot provide a replacement.

Submit your request within 7 days of payment, including your account email and proof of payment. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method, subject to the payment provider’s processing time.

hak-penggunaan.title: Song Usage Rights
body: After buying the full song, you may use it for personal, non-commercial purposes — for example, playing it at a family event, giving it as a gift, or sharing it on your personal social media.
Commercial use, such as reselling the song, registering it with music distribution or streaming services, or using it in paid advertising, is not allowed without our written consent.
We may use songs and lyrics anonymously (without names or personal data) to improve the quality of the Service. We will not feature your song as a public sample without your permission.

larangan.title: Prohibited Use
body: You may not try to access full songs without paying, disrupt or overload the system, use bots or automated scripts, or abuse quotas, vouchers, or security vulnerabilities of the Service.
Violations may result in restricted access, account deactivation, and cancellation of purchases.

privasi.title: Personal Data
body: We process questionnaire answers, email addresses, and technical data only as needed to create songs, run accounts, process payments, and prevent abuse. We do not sell your personal data to anyone.
You can request deletion of your account and song data by contacting us.

tanggung-jawab.title: Limitation of Liability
body: The Service is provided "as is". We work to keep the Service available, but we do not guarantee that it will be free of interruptions or errors.
To the extent permitted by law, our liability for any claim relating to a song is limited to the amount you paid for that song.

hukum.title: Governing Law
body: These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any dispute will first be resolved through good-faith discussion (musyawarah).

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Questions about these terms, payments, or refunds? Send us a message through the <link>contact page</link> or email <mail>{email}</mail>.

birthday.name: Birthday Song
birthday.metaTitle: Personalized Birthday Song with Their Name & Your Memories
birthday.metaDescription: Create a birthday song for your partner, mum, best friend or child. Lyrics from your memories, their name in the song, in the genre they love. Free preview.
birthday.h1: A birthday song that sings their name
birthday.intro: Everyone gets the same “Happy Birthday”. This year, give them a song that could only be sung for them: their nickname, your story together, and your wishes for the year ahead.
lyric: Twenty-five candles shining bright tonight,
I still hear you laughing in the old canteen,
Dinda, may every dream of yours come true,
and I’ll be here for every chapter that’s new.

reasons.title: More memorable than a gift
reasons.body: Things get forgotten. A song with their name in it gets played every birthday.

reasons.title: For anyone
reasons.body: Partners, parents, best friends, colleagues, even little kids who love happy songs.

reasons.title: Ready in minutes
reasons.body: No gift yet? The song can be ready today.

ideas: Their nickname or a pet name
A little habit of theirs that always makes you smile
Your best moment together this year
Your wishes for the year ahead
birthday.genres: Upbeat pop, acoustic or dangdut for a party mood. Ballad for a parent’s or partner’s birthday.

faqs.q: Can the song mention their name?
faqs.a: Yes. Write their name or nickname in the questionnaire and we put it in the lyrics.

faqs.q: Does it work for a child’s birthday?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick a cheerful mood or the lullaby genre, and tell us what they love.

faqs.q: How do I give it to them?
faqs.a: Once you buy the full song, download it and play it when they blow out the candles, or send it on WhatsApp.

anniversary.name: Anniversary Song
anniversary.metaTitle: Personalized Anniversary Song from Your Love Story
anniversary.metaDescription: Celebrate your anniversary with a song written from your story: how you met, when you fell in love, and what’s ahead. Choose the genre and voice. Free preview.
anniversary.h1: An anniversary song from your own love story
anniversary.intro: Every couple has a story nobody else has. Turn yours into a song, from the day you met to today.
anniversary.lyricMeta: For Raka · 5 years together · Romantic ballad
lyric: Five years ago at a rain-soaked stop,
you shared your umbrella and half of your steps,
Raka, we grew from the smallest things,
and I still choose you, every day.

reasons.title: Your story, not someone else’s song
reasons.body: Love songs on the radio are written for everyone. This one only fits the two of you.

reasons.title: For any anniversary
reasons.body: One month, five years, or a 25th wedding anniversary.

reasons.title: A surprise you can replay
reasons.body: Play it over dinner, set it to a memory video, or send it right at midnight.

ideas: Where and how you first met
The moment you knew they were the one
A hard time you got through together
Your promises or dreams for the future
anniversary.genres: Ballad and acoustic for a romantic feel, R&B or jazz for a dinner mood.

faqs.q: Does it work for a wedding anniversary?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us about your marriage, including children or family moments you want mentioned.

faqs.q: Can it be in English?
faqs.a: Yes. Lyrics are available in Indonesian and English.

faqs.q: What if it isn’t quite right?
faqs.a: You can regenerate the song from the same answers to get different lyrics and a different arrangement.

wedding.name: Wedding Song
wedding.metaTitle: Personalized Wedding Song for the Couple, a Gift, or the Reception
wedding.metaDescription: A wedding song written from the couple’s story: a gift for friends, a surprise at the reception, or a song for your own partner. Pick a genre, free preview.
wedding.h1: A wedding song that tells their story
wedding.intro: For your partner on your wedding day, or as a gift for friends and family who are getting married. A song about their journey to the aisle.
lyric: From different cities you both set out,
brought together by prayers that never tired,
Sekar and Bima, today you are one,
may your home always be full of laughter.

reasons.title: A gift nobody else will bring
reasons.body: Other guests bring things. You bring a song that belongs only to them.

reasons.title: Bring the reception to life
reasons.body: Play it for the grand entrance, the first dance, or with their love-story video.

reasons.title: From anyone’s point of view
reasons.body: From one partner to the other, from friends, or from family.

ideas: How they first met
What makes them right for each other
The proposal or the wedding preparations
Your wishes for their life together
wedding.genres: Pop and ballad for a modern reception, keroncong or jazz for a warm, classic feel.

faqs.q: Can it be played at the reception?
faqs.a: Yes. Download the full song and give it to the event team or MC.

faqs.q: Can it mention both of their names?
faqs.a: Yes. Write both names in the questionnaire and tell us their story.

faqs.q: How long does it take?
faqs.a: Usually a few minutes after you send your answers, so there is still time right before the big day.

proposal.name: Proposal Song
proposal.metaTitle: Personalized Proposal Song: A Romantic Surprise Before You Ask
proposal.metaDescription: Create a proposal song from your love story to lead into “will you marry me?”. Personal lyrics, your choice of genre, free preview with no sign-up.
proposal.h1: A proposal song for your biggest moment
proposal.intro: Let the song set the scene. Tell us your story, and when the last chorus ends, all that’s left is for you to ask.
lyric: We once got lost on the road to Dieng,
but with you, even lost felt like home,
Nadia, tonight I want to ask you,
will you be my home forever?

reasons.title: A surprise they’ll remember for life
reasons.body: You only propose once. A song about the two of you makes it far more personal.

reasons.title: Helps you say what you feel
reasons.body: Not great with words? Just tell us the story and we turn it into lyrics.

reasons.title: Play it anywhere
reasons.body: Over dinner, on the beach, or on a video call if you’re far apart.

ideas: When you realised you wanted to spend your life with them
A trip or place that means a lot to you both
What you want to promise them
The question, in your own words
proposal.genres: Acoustic and ballad for a tender moment. Pop or R&B for something more relaxed.

faqs.q: Will my partner find out beforehand?
faqs.a: Not unless you tell them. You can listen to the preview on your own without an account.

faqs.q: Can I choose a male or female singer?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick a male or female voice, or let us choose.

faqs.q: Does it work for a family engagement event?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us about the event and pick a fitting mood, such as moving or grateful.

mothersDay.name: Song for Mum
mothersDay.metaTitle: Song for Mum: A Personal Gift for Mother’s Day or Her Birthday
mothersDay.metaDescription: Thank your mum with a song made from your childhood memories. For Indonesian Mother’s Day on 22 December, her birthday, or just to say you love her. Free preview.
mothersDay.h1: A song for Mum, from memories only you two share
mothersDay.intro: Her signature dish, the advice you used to ignore, the prayers that never stopped. Weave it all into a song for Mum, perfect for Mother’s Day on 22 December or any day.
mothersDay.lyricMeta: For Mama · Mother’s Day · Moving ballad
lyric: Sour soup on the table when I came home from school,
your warm hands wiping all my tiredness away,
Mama, I’m sorry I rarely say thank you,
this song is for you, from the child still learning.

reasons.title: The thank-you that’s hard to say
reasons.body: Many of us rarely tell Mum we love her face to face. A song can say it for you.

reasons.title: A gift she can replay
reasons.body: A song she can listen to again and play for the whole family.

reasons.title: From the whole family
reasons.body: Bring together stories from siblings or grandchildren in one song.

ideas: Her cooking or a habit you miss most
Advice from her you still remember
A sacrifice you only understood as an adult
A thank-you or apology you never got to say
mothersDay.genres: Ballad and keroncong for an emotional feel, pop or dangdut for a mum who loves to sing.

faqs.q: When is Mother’s Day in Indonesia?
faqs.a: Indonesian Mother’s Day is on 22 December. Songs are usually ready in minutes, so you can make one any time.

faqs.q: Can it remember a mum who has passed away?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose a moving mood and tell us your memories of her.

faqs.q: Can it be for a mother-in-law or grandmother?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the recipient in the questionnaire and tell us about your relationship.

fathersDay.name: Song for Dad
fathersDay.metaTitle: Song for Dad: A Personal Gift for Father’s Day or His Birthday
fathersDay.metaDescription: Dads rarely talk about feelings, but a song can. Make a song for Dad from your memories, for Father’s Day on 12 November, his birthday or retirement. Free preview.
fathersDay.h1: A song for Dad, the hero who rarely talks about himself
fathersDay.intro: The old motorbike that took you to school, the corny jokes, the hard work he never complained about. Turn it all into a song for Dad.
lyric: On the back seat of your old motorbike,
I learned what it means to come home on time,
Bapak, your shoulders never said they were tired,
now it’s my turn to say: thank you, Pak.

reasons.title: For dads who rarely talk feelings
reasons.body: A song says what feels awkward to say out loud.

reasons.title: Fits many moments
reasons.body: Father’s Day, his birthday, retirement, or your first paycheck.

reasons.title: A genre he’ll like
reasons.body: From keroncong and dangdut to pop and jazz.

ideas: A habit or phrase only Dad says
Something he taught you that you still use
Times he was always there for you
Something you want to tell him but haven’t yet
fathersDay.genres: Acoustic and ballad for a warm feel, keroncong or dangdut for a dad who loves the classics.

faqs.q: When is Father’s Day in Indonesia?
faqs.a: Indonesian National Father’s Day is on 12 November. You can make a song any time, and it is usually ready in minutes.

faqs.q: Can it be for a grandfather or father-in-law?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the recipient in the questionnaire and tell us your memories.

faqs.q: How do I play it for Dad?
faqs.a: Download the full song and play it on your phone or a speaker, or send it on WhatsApp.

graduation.name: Graduation Song
graduation.metaTitle: Personalized Graduation Song: A Gift for Your Child, Partner or Friend
graduation.metaDescription: Celebrate a graduation with a song about the journey: late nights, endless revisions, and finally the gown. A personal graduation gift, free preview.
graduation.h1: A graduation song that celebrates the journey
graduation.intro: Behind the gown are late nights, endless revisions, and the people who kept cheering. Tell us about the journey and we turn it into a graduation song.
graduation.lyricMeta: For Aldo · Bachelor’s degree · Upbeat pop
lyric: Chapter four once made you want to quit,
instant coffee and midnight revisions,
Aldo, today that gown is yours,
your next step has only just begun.

reasons.title: More meaningful than flowers
reasons.body: Flowers wilt in a week. A song about their journey can be played any time.

reasons.title: For every level
reasons.body: Kindergarten, school, university, all the way to a master’s or PhD.

reasons.title: Great for memory videos
reasons.body: Use it as the soundtrack for a video of their school or university years.

ideas: The hardest challenge during school or university
Their quirks while working on the final project
The people who stood by them until graduation
Your hopes for their next step
graduation.genres: Pop with an upbeat mood for a celebration. Ballad or acoustic for a message from parents.

faqs.q: Does it work for a kindergarten graduation?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick a cheerful mood and tell us the funny or proud moments from school.

faqs.q: Can it be from parents to their child?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose your child as the recipient and tell their story from your point of view.

faqs.q: Can I download it for a video?
faqs.a: Yes. After you buy the full song you can download it and use it in your personal memory video.

valentine.name: Valentine’s Song
valentine.metaTitle: Personalized Valentine’s Song for Your Partner
valentine.metaDescription: A Valentine’s gift that isn’t generic: a love song from your story, with their name, in the genre they love. Ready in minutes, free preview.
valentine.h1: A Valentine’s song that only fits the two of you
valentine.intro: Chocolate is gone in a day and flowers wilt in a week. This year, give them a love song written from your own story.
lyric: You always order your iced tea with no sugar,
but your smile is sweeter than it should be,
Tara, on this day of love,
I just want to say: I’m falling for you again.

reasons.title: Not a generic gift
reasons.body: No other couple has the same song.

reasons.title: Perfect for long-distance couples
reasons.body: Send the song from afar so your feelings still arrive.

reasons.title: Works last minute
reasons.body: Forgot the gift? The song is ready in minutes.

ideas: A small thing about them that made you fall in love
Your first date or a funny moment together
The pet names you use for each other
Something you want to say but feel shy about
valentine.genres: R&B and pop for a sweet mood, acoustic or ballad for something deeper.

faqs.q: Does it work if we just started dating?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us how you got close. The song can be light and playful.

faqs.q: Can it be in English?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose English when you fill in the questionnaire.

faqs.q: How do I send it?
faqs.a: Download the full song, then send it on WhatsApp or play it when you meet.
